Meena Bai submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000300. A witness, Ramesh Pandian, reachable on 9000000469, was mentioned in the complaint. Karthik Rajan (mobile 9000000091) was named as a possible person of interest. A car bearing the number TN-47-ZZ-1095 was seen leaving the area. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00288, as the mobile number 9000000091 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
